source_roles: TRAIN only,24whole worlds; no development data in source statistics, projection checks, fitting or parameter selection
transform: Only raw movement means0:2 AFTER existing motor. desired=tanh(source_mean), previous=features13:15 (actual previous sent forward/side /400). blended=(1-rho)*desired+rho*clamp(previous,-1,1). mean=atanh(clamp(blended,-1+eps,1-eps)). rho0 short-circuits to exact source output.
gaussian: Movement log_std0:2 add0.5*log(1-rho*rho); angle std unchanged. This is a specified noise budget rule, not a claim of equal stationary variance in nonlinear game dynamics. Density is conditional on the observed previous executed command; no hidden noise state or temporal RNG correlation.
variants: noise-only: same movement std change, source mean
inertia: rho0.65 mean transform plus same std change
hypotheses: Persistent movement may reduce per-frame reversals; pure variance reduction is a separate alternative. Faster aim/target/fire policy remains source and retains its normal movement coupling. No hardcoded target/evade direction or gaze servo.
stages: CUDA real-history source cache and descriptive TRAIN statistics
CUDA zero identity/nonzero scope/conditional Gaussian density and reload
Native zero/source compatibility on4maps, real CUDA replay
Only if promising: fresh24-case source/winner/rules check; then explicit PPO initializer/checkpoint/optimizer/retention migration before training under the new transform
admission: No automatic promotion. Primary native alive-goal/death/received comparisons; actual shot and movement diagnostics secondary. Inertia must be compared to both source and noise-only to identify the effect of mean feedback. If gains come only from noise-only, prefer simpler candidate. Offline statistics never prove quality.
